test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is the largest of all the duns of the Shiwaliks mountain range in India?
solution:
Correct Answer **Dehra Dun**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• **Dehra dun**, also known as **dehradun**, is the **largest dun (valley)** in the **shiwalik mountain range in india.**
 
• It is located in the state of **uttarakhand in northern india.**
